preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 80000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of valid pairs of paths as a string.
